svg.title: Figure 18.1 · Three ways to dispatch
svg.desc: Sparse: each expert gathers its own tokens (expert 2: tokens 0, 1, 3, 4) and runs once. Dense: every expert runs on all five tokens and a weight matrix with zeros removes the unchosen outputs. Grouped: the ten slots are sorted by expert into runs ending at offsets 3, 4, 8 and 10, and one grouped matrix multiply runs them all.
svg.text: Three ways to dispatch the same ten slots
five tokens, A = 2, E = 4 · the example of ch18_dispatch_balance.py · expert 2 in gold · illustrative
each expert runs on all 5 tokens;
Each run of rows meets its own expert's matrix in one kernel call; shapes depend on N, A and E only.
